title: Intent Yonetimi Sayfasi — CRUD + Dashboard UI
summary: Tenant intent_patterns tablosunu yoneten superadmin Dashboard sayfasi. Knowledge CRUD endpoints + Backend ops proxy + React UI. 3 katman: Knowledge API → Backend proxy → Dashboard IntentManagementPage.

verification_questions.question: Do the Knowledge CRUD endpoints properly validate tenant ownership (GetValidatedTenant)?
Does InsertIntentAsync handle ON CONFLICT correctly to prevent duplicate intent names per tenant?
Does the Backend ops proxy correctly route to Knowledge service with service JWT?
Does the React IntentManagementPage handle error states and empty states properly?
